high_level_description: The image is a meme featuring two panels from the classic animated series "Tom and Jerry." In the top panel, there is an open book with a page that contains text. The text reads: "People don't pirate old games to play them for free, they pirate them to keep them alive because the original cartridges won't last forever." The background of the book page has small illustrations of mice, which are likely references to the characters from the show. In the bottom panel, Tom, the red cat character from the series, is depicted holding the same book.
